scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster uses saf-test as a training namespace and a case-owned production namespace. Two fixed ServiceAccounts access only inert, application-owned synthetic ConfigMaps. Matched SubjectAccessReview decisions show no access before scoped Roles, then namespace-scoped own-reference access while cross-environment access remains denied. A stable ValidatingAdmissionPolicy denies an inference Pod volume referencing the training ConfigMap; server dry-run compares the same request before and after policy enrollment, and admits the valid inference reference. This establishes bounded namespace/RBAC and Pod-volume admission behavior for synthetic references only. Cloud workload identity federation, real credentials or data, production clusters, other reference forms, and organization-wide production coverage require separate evidence.

checks.claim: Both fixed subjects lack access to the application-owned references before grants
Namespace-scoped Roles allow each fixed subject its own named reference and deny both cross-environment reads
